entities.title: UTV 1.0 structural schema
entities.summary: schema/utv-1.0.schema.json, JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 with $id urn:utv:schema:1.0: the shapes and field names of utv/1.0 values, not their meaning.
consumers: tools/validate.py, which checks the schema itself, the conformance examples and every UTV value in the operation fixtures against it
The C# library, which embeds the file at build time (implementations/csharp/src/Utv/Utv.csproj), and the Rust crate, which compiles it in (implementations/rust/src/lib.rs, SCHEMA_TEXT)
The Python library, which ships a byte copy as package data (implementations/python/src/utv/data/)
The Java and TypeScript libraries, whose kind tables are hand copies of it (KindTable; src/structural.ts KINDS)
Any outside tool that validates UTV JSON
guarantees: One file per MAJOR.MINOR, named utv-MAJOR.MINOR.schema.json, with $id urn:utv:schema:MAJOR.MINOR.
It validates shapes only: a value can pass it and still be semantically invalid or unresolvable (DECISIONS item 18).
It rejects the unreleased draft identifiers utv/2, utv/3 and utv/4.
entities.compatibility: Older schema files are kept unchanged when newer ones are added. A patch release may correct a schema file only to make it match the already-published prose, and lists the correction in CHANGELOG.md (VERSIONING.md, Schema files).
